correctness.rationale: Direct argument: two Johnson clique families share no 2-faces, so decreasing-cardinality elementary collapses reduce the Rips flag complex to dimension two; the hypersimplex boundary 2-skeleton has the same graph one-skeleton and is simply connected, forcing pi_1=0; exact f-vector and Hurewicz/Whitehead give the wedge with stated multiplicity. Finite verifier rebuilt 15 Johnson graphs, checked 2,872 free-face collapse pairs and computed exact GF(2) ranks. Finite checks are supporting, not all-parameter proof.
